_source: Aircraft shapes and type-to-icon tables from tar1090 html/markers.js (https://github.com/wiedehopf/tar1090, GPL-2.0-or-later); type descriptions from tar1090-db icao_aircraft_types2.js (https://github.com/wiedehopf/tar1090-db). Converted from those sources; path data rewritten with explicit separators so Android's PathParser can read it.
